title: The Visigoths sack Rome
summary: Visigoths under Alaric entered and plundered Rome for three days. It was the first time in 800 years the city fell to a foreign enemy.
reason: Alaric's demands for land and payment for his people were refused by Emperor Honorius in Ravenna.
significance: The sack shocked the Roman world and inspired Augustine to write The City of God.
